summary: The diff addresses all six requirements. REQ-1 is covered by the corrected profile route in App.tsx (/profile/$userId). REQ-2 is covered by Profile.tsx reading the correct param and using appropriate hooks for own vs other profiles. REQ-3 is covered by Layout.tsx and VideoCard.tsx using the correct route path with userId param. REQ-4 is covered by modifications to backend/main.mo. REQ-5 is covered by useQueries.ts correctly extracting UserProfile from the ProfileResult discriminated union. REQ-6 is covered by broad fixes across the frontend codebase. However, there are some gaps around specific REQ-3 components (Notifications.tsx, Leaderboard.tsx, Conversation.tsx, Inbox.tsx are not listed as modified) and the diff is truncated so full verification of REQ-4 backend changes and REQ-6 cache invalidation is limited.

missing_requirements.requirement: Audit all navigation links and programmatic navigations throughout the app including Notifications.tsx, Leaderboard.tsx, Conversation.tsx, and Inbox.tsx that link to a user profile page.
missing_requirements.reason: The diff only lists modifications to Layout.tsx and VideoCard.tsx among the profile-link components. Notifications.tsx, Leaderboard.tsx, Conversation.tsx, and Inbox.tsx are not listed in the modified files, so it cannot be confirmed that profile links in those components were audited and fixed.
